description: Four spears of stone travel in straight lines converging on a point within range. Any creature between a spear and the convergence point makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 2d6 bludgeoning; half on a success. +1 additional spear per slot level above 3rd.

name: Stonja (Stone IV)
description: You raise a 20ft square of land 20ft into the air. Raised slowly, creatures are lifted harmlessly. Raised quickly, each creature makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 6d6 bludgeoning and is knocked prone; half and no other effect on a success. +2d6 (quick) per slot level above 5th.

name: Water
description: You conjure a globe of water and hurl it at one or two creatures within range (if two, they must be within 5ft of each other). A target makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Increases to 2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, and 4d6 at 17th level.

name: Watera (Water II)
description: You release a focused burst of water at a creature within range. It makes a Strength saving throw or takes 3d6 bludgeoning and falls prone or is pushed 30ft (your choice). +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Waterga (Water III)
description: An aquatic prison forms around a Large or smaller creature within range. It makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 3d10 cold and is engulfed: it can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 3d10 cold at the start of each turn. It may use an action to make a Strength save vs your DC to pop the bubble. +1d10 initial per slot level above 3rd.

name: Waterja (Water IV)
description: A powerful geyser (20ft-radius cylinder, 40ft high) erupts within range. Each creature makes a Strength saving throw or takes 6d8 bludgeoning and is thrown 20ft straight back from the closest edge; half and no other effect on a success. +1d8 per slot level above 5th.

name: Dark
description: You form an orb of necrotic energy and fire it at a target within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, 3d8 necrotic damage. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Darkra
description: You swing your necrotic-filled limb, sending a wave of energy out in a 30ft cone. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 3d8 necrotic on a failure and half on a success. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Darkga
description: You concentrate necrotic energy beneath a target within range. All creatures within a 20ft radius make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 8d6 necrotic on a failure and half on a success. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

name: Darkja (Dark IV)
description: You release a flood of necrotic energy around you. All creatures within a 40ft radius make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 8d8 necrotic on a failure and half on a success. +1d8 per slot level above 5th.

name: Ruin
description: You gather unaspected aether and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d10 force damage. Increases to 2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th level.

name: Ruinra (Ruin II)
description: A burst of unaspected aether ravages a 10ft-radius sphere within range. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 2d10 force; half on a success. +1d10 per slot level above 1st.

name: Ruinga (Ruin III)
description: You conjure 4 shining bolts of pure energy. Make a ranged spell attack against a target in range for each bolt; on a hit, 2d8 force. +1 additional bolt per slot level above 3rd.

name: Ruinja (Ruin IV)
description: A barrage of energy bolts rains in a 20ft-radius circle within range. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 4d8 force; half on a success. As an action each turn, call the barrage again at the same or a different point. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Jolt
description: A shard of crystallized aether streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d8 force damage. Creates additional shards at higher levels: two at 5th, three at 11th, four at 17th. Make a separate attack roll for each shard.

name: Malefic
description: You gather astral energy and launch it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d8 force damage. Increases to 2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, and 4d8 at 17th level.

name: Scathe
description: You cause an aetheric disruption at a creature within range. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 force on a failure and half on a success. +1d6 per slot level above 1st.

name: Gravity
description: A dense celestial body appears at a point within range, creating a 20ft-radius gravitational field. Each creature in the field makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 force on a failure and half on a success. +1d6 per slot level above 5th.

name: Comet
description: Three shards of pure aether crash down at points within range, each exploding in a 20ft radius. Each creature in an affected area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 force on a failure and half on a success (a creature hit by multiple comets saves once but takes damage from each). +1 additional comet per slot level above 4th.

name: Meteor
description: A massive shard of crystallized aether drops at a location within range, exploding in a 50ft-radius sphere. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 force on a failure and half on a success. +3d6 per slot level above 8th.

name: Demi
description: You manipulate the gravity around a creature within range. It makes a Strength saving throw or takes 1d4 force damage and falls prone. Increases to 2d4 at 5th, 3d4 at 11th, and 4d4 at 17th level.

name: Demira
description: You manipulate gravity in a 20ft-radius circle within range. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 1d6 force and is launched 20ft straight up, taking falling damage (1d10 bludgeoning per 10ft) on landing; half and not launched on a success. +10ft launch height per slot level above 2nd.

name: Demi Ultima
description: An incredible burst of aether fills a 60ft-radius sphere within range. All creatures make a Dexterity saving throw or take 40d6 force damage; half on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points is disintegrated.

name: Holy
description: An orb of radiant energy explodes above you. You and designated allies are immune. All other creatures within a 40ft-radius sphere make a Constitution saving throw or take 4d8 radiant plus 4d8 force and are stunned until the start of your next turn; half and resist the stun on a success. +2d8 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Foul
description: You tear a hole in reality, ravaging a 40ft-radius sphere within range. All creatures make a Charisma saving throw or take 4d10 necrotic plus 4d10 force; half on a success.

name: Freeze
description: A flash-freezing storm forms in a 40ft-radius sphere within range. All creatures make a Constitution saving throw or take 5d6 cold plus 5d6 force and are restrained until the end of their next turn; half and not restrained on a success. Surfaces become slick ice for 1 minute. +2d6 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Flood
description: An instantaneous flood bursts through a 40ft-radius sphere within range. Each creature makes a Strength saving throw, taking 4d6 cold plus 4d6 bludgeoning plus 4d6 force and knocked back 40ft on a failure, or half and knocked back 10ft on a success. +3d6 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Quake
description: A burst of raw energy pulverizes a 40ft-radius circle on the ground. All creatures make a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d8 bludgeoning plus 4d8 force and are knocked prone; half and not prone on a success. The area becomes difficult terrain. +2d8 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Tornado
description: A powerful gale forms in a 40ft-radius, 80ft-tall cylinder within range. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 5d6 thunder plus 5d6 force and is stunned until the end of its next turn; half and not stunned on a success. +3d6 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Electron
description: A storm of lightning electrifies a 40ft-radius, 80ft-tall cylinder within range. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 lightning plus 6d6 force on a failure and half on a success. Surfaces stay electrified for 1 minute; a creature starting its turn there takes 3d6 lightning. +3d6 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Celestial Opposition
description: You release astral energy in a 30ft-radius globe centered on you. On release, all enemies in contact make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 6d8 force and stunned for 1d4 rounds on a failure, or half and not stunned on a success.

name: Break
description: You hex a creature within range. It makes a Charisma saving throw, taking 3d4 force and having its speed reduced by 30ft for 1 minute on a failure; half and no other effect on a success. It repeats the save at the end of its turn to remove the hex. +1d4 and +1 target per slot level above 1st.

name: Drain
description: You draw the life force from a creature within range. It makes a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 1d8 necrotic on a failure and half on a success. You recover hit points equal to half the damage dealt. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Doom
description: You place a death curse on a creature within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw or begins to rapidly decay, taking 3d6 necrotic at the start of each of its turns and having disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. The curse ends only by killing or knocking out the caster, being on a different plane, or Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish.

name: Doomsday
description: A surging storm of negative energy fills a 20ft-radius, 80ft-high cylinder. All creatures make a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6 necrotic plus 6d6 force and a 2d4 penalty to attack rolls and saves until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half and no penalty on a success. +2d6 force per slot level above 7th.

name: Osmose
description: You drain magical energy from a creature within 30ft. It makes a Charisma saving throw, on a failure losing a 1st-level spell slot which you do not expend. At higher levels the creature loses a slot of equal level on a failed save (the recovery does not work above 5th level).

name: Xenoglossy
description: You use forbidden magicks to ravage a creature's body and soul within range. It makes a Charisma saving throw or takes 40d10 force damage; half on a success. If reduced to 0 hit points, the creature dies and its soul is destroyed, restorable only by Wish.

name: De-Element
description: A creature within range makes a Wisdom saving throw or gains a vulnerability to one damage type you choose (bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, radiant, or thunder). If immune to that type, it instead becomes resistant. +1 creature per slot level above 4th.

name: Imperil
description: A creature within range makes a Wisdom saving throw or gains vulnerability to all of these damage types: bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, radiant, and thunder. If immune to a type, it takes normal damage from it instead.

name: En-Element
description: You empower a weapon with a damage type you choose. Its damage becomes magical; on a hit it deals bonus damage of that type equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, and attacks may use your spellcasting ability modifier for attack and damage rolls. +1 additional weapon within 5ft per slot level above 3rd.

name: Bravery
description: You fill a creature within range with vigor. Their weapon attacks deal bonus damage equal to their proficiency bonus, and they are immune to being frightened. +1 creature per slot level above 1st.

name: Faith
description: You reinforce a creature's mental fortitude. Their spell damage gains a bonus equal to their proficiency bonus, and they have advantage on Wisdom saving throws. +1 creature per slot level above 2nd.

name: Protection
description: You cover a creature within range in a protective barrier. Damage from bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing is reduced by your spellcasting ability modifier. +1 creature per slot level above 4th.

name: Shell
description: You cover a creature within range in a protective shell. Damage from all types except bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing is reduced by your spellcasting ability modifier. +1 creature per slot level above 4th.

name: Sacred Soil
description: You create a 10ft-radius dome of protective magic centered within range. When an ally within the dome takes damage, the damage is reduced by 1d6. +1d6 reduction per slot level above 4th.

name: Cure
description: A creature within range regains 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. No effect on undead or constructs. +1d6 per slot level above 1st.

name: Cura (Medica)
description: You release curative energy in a 20ft-radius sphere around you. Each allied creature regains 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. No effect on undead or constructs. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

name: Curada (Cure II)
description: A creature within range regains 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points and gains 1d6 temporary hit points. No effect on undead or constructs. +1d6 temp HP per slot level above 1st.

name: Curaga (Cure III)
description: A creature within range and each allied creature within 20ft of it regains 3d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. No effect on undead or constructs. +2d6 per slot level above 4th.

name: Curaja (Cure IV)
description: A creature within range and each allied creature within 20ft of it regains 3d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. While you concentrate, the healed creatures recover 1d6 hit points at the start of their turn. No effect on undead or constructs. +1d6 initial per slot level above 5th.

name: Lustrate
description: Cast as an action, or as a reaction when a creature takes damage. A creature within range recovers 3d8 hit points. +1d8 per slot level above 4th.

name: Tetragammaton
description: Cast as an action, or as a reaction when a creature takes damage. A creature within range is healed for 3d8 hit points instantaneously. +1d8 per slot level above 4th.

name: Assize
description: An eruption of energy soothes allies and wounds enemies. All allies within 60ft recover 3d8 hit points. All enemies within 60ft make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 4d4 radiant on a failure and half on a success. You may swap which die heals and which deals damage (decide before rolling). +dice per slot level above 5th.

name: Asylum
description: You create a 30ft-radius globe of holy energy within range. Allied creatures inside recover 1d8 hit points at the start of their turn and gain resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and to necrotic damage. +1d8 per slot level above 5th.

name: Collective Unconscious
description: You create a 30ft-radius spherical barrier around yourself. All allies within 10ft are healed for 3d8 immediately. While inside the barrier, their AC gains +1 and they are healed 1d6 at the start of their turn. +1d6 per slot level above 5th.

name: Esuna
description: You cleanse a creature within 30ft, curing blindness, deafness, paralysis, and poison. +1 additional creature per slot level above 3rd.

name: Regen
description: The target's body is enchanted to repair over time. For the duration, it regains 1d6 hit points at the start of its turn. +1d6 per slot level above 4th.

turnResource.label: Regen: heal 1d6 at start of turn

name: Refresh
description: You share your aetheric power. A creature within range recovers one expended 1st-level spell slot. At higher levels, the creature recovers a slot one level lower than the slot used to cast Refresh.

name: Veraero
description: You burst wind aether around a creature within range. It makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 2d8 thunder. If it already took damage on your turn, it takes an additional 2d6 force. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Veraeroga (Veraero III)
description: A swirling wind vortex forms in a 10ft-radius, 40ft-high cylinder within range, becoming difficult terrain. A creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting there takes 2d4 thunder plus 2d4 slashing; moving within the area deals an extra 2d4 slashing per 5ft traveled. +2d4 thunder (first entry) per slot level above 3rd.

name: Verfire
description: You launch a streaking bolt of fire at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, 3d8 fire. If the target already took damage on your turn, it takes an additional 2d6 force. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Verflare
description: A localized fire explosion erupts in a 10ft-radius sphere within range. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 4d8 fire. If any already took damage this turn, they take an additional 2d8 force. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Verholy
description: Light erupts beneath an enemy within range in a 10ft-radius, 30ft-high cylinder. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 4d8 radiant. If any already took damage this turn, they take an additional 2d8 force. +1d8 per slot level above 3rd.

name: Verstone
description: Two stone spears travel in straight lines toward a point within range. Each creature in a spear's path makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d12 bludgeoning; a creature at the destination saves once but takes damage from all spears (half on success). +1 additional spear per slot level above 1st.

name: Verthunder
description: You rain lightning aether in a 30ft-high, 5ft-radius cylinder within range. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 3d6 lightning; half on a success. If a creature already took damage on your turn, it takes an additional 2d6 force. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Verthundaga (Verthunder III)
description: A burst of lightning explodes in a 20ft-radius sphere within range. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d8 lightning on a failure and half on a success. +1d8 explosion per slot level above 3rd.

name: Heat Metal
components: V, S, M (a piece of iron and a flame)
description: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your subsequent turns to cause this damage again. If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can; if it doesn't, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn. +1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Acid Splash
description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or two within 5ft of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage. Scales to 2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th.

name: Blade Ward
description: You trace a sigil of warding. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

name: Friends
description: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile to you. When the spell ends, the creature realizes you used magic and becomes hostile.

name: Infestation
description: You cause a cloud of mites to assail a creature. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 poison damage and move 5ft in a random direction. Scales to 2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th.

name: Magic Stone
description: You imbue up to three pebbles with magic. You or someone else can make a ranged spell attack by throwing one or using a sling. On a hit, it deals 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier bludgeoning damage. Scales with your level.

name: Mending
description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it.

name: Message
description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper only you can hear. You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier.

name: Primal Savagery
description: You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within 5ft. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 acid damage. Scales to 2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 17th.

name: Resistance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.

name: Sapping Sting
description: You sap the vitality of one creature within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 necrotic damage and fall prone. Scales to 2d4 at 5th, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th.

name: True Strike
description: You point a finger at a target in range. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn't ended.

name: Absorb Elements
description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. On your first melee hit before then, the target takes an extra 1d6 of the triggering type. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

name: Alarm
components: V, S, M (a bell and silver wire)
description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. Can be audible or mental.

name: Catapult
description: Choose one object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within range that isn't held or worn. The object flies in a straight line up to 90ft before falling, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning to the first creature it hits (Dexterity save for no damage and the object stops). +1d8 and +5 lb per slot above 1st.

name: Comprehend Languages
description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case.

name: Feather Fall
description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before then, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet.

name: Find Familiar
components: V, S, M (charcoal, incense, and herbs worth 10gp)
description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose. It has the chosen form's statistics and acts independently but obeys your commands. While it is within 100ft you can communicate telepathically and can see through its senses as an action.

name: Ice Knife
description: You create a shard of ice and fling it. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d10 piercing. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes: each creature within 5ft of the target makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 cold. +1d6 cold per slot above 1st.

name: Snare
description: You create a magic snare in a 5-foot-square you touch. A creature entering the area makes a Dexterity save or is magically hoisted into the air, restrained and hanging upside down. It can free itself with a successful Athletics or Acrobatics check or by dealing damage to the snare.

name: Arcane Lock
components: V, S, M (gold dust worth 25gp, consumed)
description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and creatures you designate can open the object normally. You can set a password; speaking it suppresses the lock for 1 minute. Otherwise the DC to break or pick it increases by 10.

name: Cloud of Daggers
components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
description: You fill a 5-foot cube within range with spinning daggers. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. +2d4 per slot above 2nd.

name: Enhance Ability
components: V, S, M (fur or a feather)
description: You touch a creature and bestow a magical enhancement tied to one ability (advantage on that ability's checks, plus a rider such as temp HP for Bear's Endurance or a reduced-fall benefit for Cat's Grace). +1 target per slot above 2nd.

name: Earthbind
description: Choose one creature within range. Yellow strips of magical energy loop around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or its flying speed (if any) is reduced to 0 feet for the duration. An airborne creature is safely lowered at 60 feet per round.

name: Find Traps
description: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight. You learn the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense, but not its exact location or how to disarm it.

name: Healing Spirit
description: You call forth a nature spirit into a 5-foot cube within range. When a creature enters the space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, you can heal it 1d6. The spirit can heal a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting modifier. +1d6 per slot above 2nd.

name: Immovable Object
components: V, S, M (gold dust worth 25gp, consumed)
description: You touch an object weighing no more than 10 pounds and cause it to become magically fixed in place. You and creatures you designate can move it normally. Higher slots increase the duration and the force required to move it.

name: Catnap
description: You make a calming gesture, and up to three willing creatures of your choice within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration. At the end, the targets gain the benefit of a short rest and can't be affected again until they finish a long rest. +1 target per slot above 3rd.

name: Create Food and Water
description: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing and spoils after 24 hours.

name: Feign Death
components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. The target appears dead, is blinded and incapacitated, has resistance to all damage except psychic, and has advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.

name: Glyph of Warding
components: V, S, M (incense and powdered diamond worth 200gp, consumed)
description: You inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures. Set a trigger condition; when met, the glyph erupts (explosive runes for up to 5d8 damage of a chosen type, or a stored spell of 3rd level or lower). Damage and stored-spell level scale with the slot used.

name: Life Transference
description: You sacrifice some of your health to mend another creature's injuries. You take 4d8 necrotic damage (not reducible), and one creature of your choice within range regains twice that much. +1d8 per slot above 3rd.

name: Magic Circle
components: V, S, M (holy water or powdered silver and iron worth 100gp, consumed)
description: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy. Choose one or more creature types; they can't willingly enter by nonmagical means, have disadvantage on attacks against creatures inside, and can't charm, frighten, or possess them. You can reverse it to trap a creature inside.

name: Meld into Stone
description: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and your equipment with the stone. You can sense what happens immediately outside and use your movement to leave, but otherwise you can't see or act.

name: Major Image
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: You create the image of an object, creature, or other visible phenomenon no larger than a 20-foot cube, including sound, smell, and temperature. You can move the image and change its actions as an action. Cast at 6th level or higher, it lasts until dispelled without concentration.

name: Motivational Speech
description: [Acquisitions Incorporated] You deliver a rousing speech to up to five creatures of your choice within range. Each gains 5 temporary hit points and advantage on Wisdom saving throws. While it has the temp HP, it also has advantage on an attack roll or Wisdom save it makes each turn. +1 target per slot above 3rd.

name: Ashardalon's Stride
description: [Fizban's] The billowing flames of a dragon appear around you. Your speed increases by 20ft and moving out of a creature's reach doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. A creature within 5ft when you move takes 1d6 fire damage. +5ft speed and +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Enemies Abound
description: [Xanathar's] You reach into the mind of one creature you can see and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe, treating all creatures as enemies until the spell ends. It must use its action to attack the nearest creature and is frightened of you.

name: Pulse Wave
description: [Explorer's Guide to Wildemount] You create intense pressure in a 30-foot cone. Each creature makes a Constitution save, taking 6d6 force on a failure (half on success). You choose whether to pull affected creatures 15ft toward you or push them 15ft away. +1d6 and +5ft displacement per slot above 3rd.

name: Aura of Life
description: Life-preserving energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) has resistance to necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum can't be reduced. A creature at 0 HP that starts its turn in the aura regains 1 HP.

name: Earth Tremor
description: You cause a tremor in the ground within range. Each creature other than you in a 10-foot radius makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 bludgeoning and is knocked prone. Loose earth in the area becomes difficult terrain. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

name: Sickening Radiance
description: Dim green light fills a 30-foot-radius sphere. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save or takes 4d10 radiant damage, gains one level of exhaustion, and glows until the spell ends.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
components: V, S, M (a drop of giant slug secretion)
description: You point at a spot and a 20-foot-radius sphere of emerald acid erupts. Each creature makes a Dexterity save: on a failure, 10d4 acid damage and 5d4 acid at the end of its next turn; on a success, half initial and no ongoing. +2d4 per slot above 4th.

name: Find the Path
description: You can find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location you are familiar with. For the duration, as long as you are on the same plane as the destination, you know how far and in what direction it is and sense the most direct route.

name: Bigby's Hand
components: V, S, M (an eggshell and a snakeskin glove)
description: You create a Large hand of force that lasts for the duration. As a bonus action you direct it: Clenched Fist (4d8 force), Forceful Hand (shove), Grasping Hand (grapple, 2d6+ crush), or Interposing Hand (half cover). +2d8 fist / +2d6 crush per slot above 5th.

name: Creation
components: V, S, M (a tiny piece of matter of the type you plan to create)
description: You pull wisps of shadow material to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter (up to a 5-foot cube) within range: soft goods, rope, wood, or similar. Denser materials and larger cubes are possible with higher slots, and the object's duration depends on its material.

name: Far Step
description: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your subsequent turns before the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again.

name: Skill Empowerment
description: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent. You touch one willing creature and give it proficiency in one chosen skill. If it is already proficient, it instead gains expertise (double proficiency) with that skill for the duration.

name: Steel Wind Strike
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1sp)
description: You flourish a weapon and vanish to strike. Choose up to five creatures you can see within range. Make a melee spell attack against each; on a hit, a target takes 6d10 force damage. You can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5ft of one of the targets.

name: Telekinesis
description: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. As an action each round, you can move a Huge or smaller creature (contested Strength check) or an object weighing up to 1,000 pounds, at a range of 60 feet.

name: Temporal Shunt
description: [Explorer's Guide to Wildemount] Cast when a creature you can see makes an attack roll or starts casting a spell. The target makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, it vanishes into the timestream, its action is negated, and it reappears at the start of its next turn in the space it left. +1 target per slot above 5th.

name: Enervation
description: A tendril of inky darkness reaches out to a creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save; on a success it takes 2d8 necrotic. On a failure it takes 4d8 necrotic and the tendril persists, dealing 4d8 each of your following turns as a bonus action while you have line of sight; you regain HP equal to half the necrotic dealt. +1d8 per slot above 5th.

name: Arcane Gate
description: You create linked teleportation portals. Choose two points on the ground you can see, one within 10ft and one within 500ft. A circular portal opens over each. Any creature or object entering one portal exits from the other as if the two were adjacent.

name: Blade Barrier
description: You create a vertical wall of whirling blades up to 100ft long, 20ft high, and 5ft thick (or a ringed wall up to 60ft in diameter). It provides three-quarters cover, and its area is difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast, or entering/ending its turn there, makes a Dexterity save or takes 6d10 slashing damage.

name: Circle of Death
components: V, S, M (the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500gp)
description: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 necrotic on a failure and half on a success. +2d6 per slot above 6th.

name: Conjure Fey
description: You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower, or a fey spirit that takes the form of a beast of CR 6 or lower. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see and is friendly to you and your companions, acting on its own but obeying your verbal commands.

name: Contingency
components: V, S, M (a statuette of yourself worth 1,500gp)
description: You cast another spell (5th level or lower, casting time 1 action, targeting you) and set a contingent circumstance. When that circumstance occurs, the contingent spell takes effect. You can have only one contingency active at a time.

name: Create Homunculus
components: V, S, M (clay, ash, mandrake root, and a gem-encrusted dagger worth 1,000gp)
description: While speaking mystic words, you cut your body (2d4 piercing) and use the blood to create a homunculus servant. It is friendly to you and obeys your commands. You have a telepathic link with it while on the same plane; you can see through its eyes as an action.

name: Eyebite
description: For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. As an action, you target one creature within 60ft; on a failed Wisdom save it suffers one effect of your choice: Asleep (unconscious), Panicked (frightened and must flee), or Sickened (poisoned).

name: Forbiddance
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,000gp, consumed)
description: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet. Creatures can't teleport into the area or use portals. Chosen creature types entering the area take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice).

name: Guards and Wards
components: V, S, M (burning incense, brimstone and oil, a knotted string, a small silver rod, and materials worth 10gp)
description: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space in a series of connected rooms or corridors, with effects like fog-filled corridors, webbed doors, magically locked portals, and a suite of guarding effects of your choice.

name: Harm
description: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature you can see. The target makes a Constitution save, taking 14d6 necrotic on a failure (half on success). Its hit point maximum is reduced by the damage taken for 1 hour. The damage can't reduce the target below 1 HP.

name: Heal
description: Choose a creature you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through it, restoring 70 hit points. It also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target. +10 HP per slot above 6th. No effect on undead or constructs.

name: Heroes' Feast
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000gp, consumed)
description: You conjure a great feast for up to twelve creatures. Eating it (1 hour) confers benefits for 24 hours: cured diseases and poison, immunity to poison and being frightened, advantage on Wisdom saves, and +2d10 hit point maximum and current HP.

name: Mental Prison
description: [Xanathar's] You attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell. The target makes an Intelligence save; on a success it takes 5d10 psychic. On a failure it takes 5d10 psychic and is restrained by the illusion of its choice of prison, taking 10d10 psychic if it tries to leave.

name: Planar Ally
description: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid. It sends a celestial, elemental, or fiend loyal to it to appear in an unoccupied space within range. You must know and name the specific creature; it acts on its own and typically requires payment for extended service.

name: Programmed Illusion
components: V, S, M (jade dust worth 25gp and a bit of fleece)
description: You create an illusion of an object, creature, or phenomenon (up to a 30-foot cube) that activates when a specific condition occurs. Once triggered, the illusion plays its programmed scene (up to 5 minutes) including sound, then repeats after 10 minutes.

name: Scatter
description: The air crackles with teleportation energy in a 30-foot cube you can see. Up to five creatures of your choice in the area must succeed on a Wisdom save or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 120ft (your choice of destinations).

name: Soul Cage
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100gp)
description: [Xanathar's] Cast when a humanoid you can see within range dies. You snatch its soul into your cage, preventing resurrection. While a soul is caged, you can expend charges for benefits: heal yourself 2d8, gain advantage on an attack/check/save, ask a question of the soul, or gain proficiency-based bonuses. The cage holds six uses.

name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
components: V, S, M (a miniature ivory door, marble stone, and silver wire)
description: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range. Its entrance is a shimmering portal only creatures you designate can enter. The opulent interior can house up to 100 people, provides food for that many, and is served by 100 near-transparent servants.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
components: V, S, M (a miniature platinum sword worth 250gp)
description: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. As a bonus action, you move it up to 20ft and make a melee spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage.

name: Mind Blank
description: You touch one willing creature to shield it against many mental effects. Until the spell ends, it is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition. The spell even foils wish spells used to affect the target's mind.

name: Telepathy
components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
description: You create a telepathic link with one willing creature you are familiar with. Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantaneously share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages through the link, regardless of distance or planes.

name: Foresight
description: You touch a willing creature and bestow limited ability to see into the near future. For the duration, it can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Attack rolls against it are made with disadvantage.

name: Gate
description: You conjure a circular portal, 5 to 20 feet in diameter, linking to a precise location on another plane you specify. The portal is a two-way doorway. You can also use it to pull a specific creature to you by speaking its name (Charisma save to resist if unwilling).

name: Imprisonment
components: V, S, M (a depiction of the target and a special component per binding, worth 500gp per HD)
description: You bind a creature you can see within range. It makes a Wisdom save or is imprisoned by one of several bindings you choose (burial in an inescapable tomb, chained down, minimus containment in a gem, hedged prison, or slumber). Ending it requires a specific dispel.

name: Power Word Heal
description: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. It regains all its hit points. If it is charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, those conditions end. If it is prone, it can use its reaction to stand. No effect on undead or constructs.

name: Prismatic Wall
description: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a wall up to 90ft long, 30ft high, and 1ft thick (or a 30-foot-diameter sphere). It has seven layers, each a different color with its own damaging or blocking effect; passing through requires overcoming every layer in order.

name: Weird
description: Drawing on the deepest fears of creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere within range, each makes a Wisdom save or takes 4d10 psychic and becomes frightened. A frightened target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking 4d10 psychic on a failure and ending the effect on a success.

name: Silent Image
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects. You can move the image within range as an action.

name: Alter Self
description: You assume a different form. Choose Aquatic Adaptation (gills, swim speed), Change Appearance, or Natural Weapons (unarmed strikes that deal 1d6 and count as magical). You can change the option as an action.

name: Nondetection
components: V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25gp, consumed)
description: For the duration, you hide a target you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Phantom Steed
description: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space within range. It has AC 13 and 1 hit point, and a speed of 100 feet. It can carry its rider at 13 miles an hour (89 for a 10-hour day). While mounted, you can't be knocked off by anyone but yourself.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: You tap into a creature's nightmares. The target makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened and takes 4d10 psychic damage. At the end of each of its turns, it must repeat the save, taking 4d10 psychic on a failure and ending the spell on a success. +1d10 per slot above 4th.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
components: V, S, M (a hemispherical piece of clear crystal and one of gum arabic)
description: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object no larger than Large within range. An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity save to avoid it. Nothing can pass through the sphere; the creature inside is safe from and unable to affect anything outside.

name: Contagion
description: Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice. The target must succeed on three Constitution saves over three turns or become fully diseased, suffering the disease's debilitating effects.

name: Seeming
description: This spell changes the appearance of any number of creatures you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance. An unwilling target makes a Charisma save to resist. The disguise lasts for the duration.

name: Scrying
components: V, S, M (a focus worth 1,000gp, such as a crystal ball or mirror)
description: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane. The target makes a Wisdom save (modified by your familiarity and any connection). On a failure, an invisible sensor appears within 10 feet of it, letting you observe as if present.

name: Mislead
description: You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell. You can use your action to move your double and make it speak or gesture, seeing and hearing through its senses.

name: Legend Lore
components: V, S, M (incense worth 250gp and four ivory strips worth 50gp each)
description: Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named, as a poem, omens, or plain telling, depending on the knowledge available.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
components: V, S, M (pieces of eggshell from two different creatures)
description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language, as long as they are on the same plane.

name: Sending
components: V, S, M (a short piece of fine copper wire)
description: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature you are familiar with. It hears the message in its mind, recognizes you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell works across planes but with a chance of failure.

name: Teleportation Circle
description: You draw a 10-foot-diameter circle inscribed with sigils that link to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know. A shimmering portal opens within the circle and remains until the end of your next turn; any creature entering it appears at the destination circle.

name: Geas
description: You place a magical command on a creature you can see, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action as you decide. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed. While charmed, it takes 5d10 psychic damage each time it acts contrary to your instructions (once per day). Higher slots extend the duration.

name: Tongues
components: V, M (a small clay model of a ziggurat)
description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

name: Water Breathing
components: V, S, M (a short reed or piece of straw)
description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

name: Water Walk
components: V, S, M (a piece of cork)
description: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface — water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava — as if it were harmless solid ground. Up to ten willing creatures you can see within range gain this ability for the duration.

name: Knock
description: Choose an object that you can see within range that is locked or stuck. The object is unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred; any mundane lock or Arcane Lock on it is suppressed. The sound of a loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target.

name: Levitate
components: V, S, M (a bit of leather and a golden wire loop)
description: One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution save to resist. You can move it up or down as part of your move on later turns.

name: True Polymorph
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke)
description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object you can see. You transform it into a different creature, creature into object, or object into creature. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom save. If you concentrate for the full hour, the transformation becomes permanent.

name: Bestow Curse
description: You touch a creature, which makes a Wisdom save or becomes cursed. Choose a curse: disadvantage on checks/attacks with one ability, disadvantage on attacks against you, forced to waste actions (Wisdom save each turn), or +1d8 necrotic from your attacks. Higher slots extend duration and remove concentration.

name: Blade of Disaster
description: [Tasha's] You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long. When you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns, you can make two melee spell attacks with it, each dealing 4d12 force damage. It scores critical hits on a roll of 18-20 and rolls three sets of dice on a crit. It ignores resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

name: Reality Break
description: [Tasha's] You shatter a creature's perception of reality. It makes a Wisdom save or can't take reactions and is subjected on each of its turns to a random effect (rolled on a table) that may deal 6d12 psychic, 8d12 bludgeoning, 10d12 fire, or force it to be stunned or teleported. It repeats the save at the end of its turns.

name: Frost Fingers
description: [Icewind Dale] Freezing cold blasts from your fingertips in a 15-foot cone. Each creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold on a failure (half on success). The cold freezes nonmagical liquids in the area that aren't being worn or carried. +1d8 per slot above 1st.

name: Protection from Poison
description: You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison you know is present, or you neutralize one at random. For the duration, the target has advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

name: Unseen Servant
components: V, S, M (a piece of string and a bit of wood)
description: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space and can carry, fetch, clean, mend, and perform similar chores at your direction.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
description: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground. It can hold up to 500 pounds and follows you, remaining within 20 feet of you and hovering over even the roughest terrain.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
components: V, S, M (a glass or crystal bead that shatters)
description: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if cast using a higher slot. Such a spell can target them but has no effect. +1 spell level blocked per slot above 6th.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver whistle, a piece of bone, and a thread)
description: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space you can see, where it remains invisible except to you. As long as it is within 30ft of you and you are visible, it barks loudly at hidden or approaching hostiles. When a creature it can see comes within 5ft of it, it makes a bite attack: +your spell attack modifier, 4d8 piercing on a hit.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
components: V, S, M (a thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton, and powdered chrysolite)
description: You make an area within range magically secure — up to a 100-foot cube. Choose any of the following: sound can't pass the boundary, sight is blocked, divination is foiled, teleportation is prevented, and creatures/objects can't pass through. You can expand the area with higher slots.

name: Power Word Stun
description: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect. The stunned target makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Power Word Kill
description: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.
